Prompt to build this component

When to use it

When to use

  • To list the named steps of a flow in order, with the current one marked: beside a step-by-step view, in a side panel, or as the plan of a flow that has no screens yet.
  • With status pills when each step has its own state (done, in review, not started).
  • To show recovery steps in their place, with a second line saying which step they recover from.

When not to use

  • For a product's top-level places: use cmp-sidebar-nav.
  • For a numbered explanation on a public page: an ordered list in the page body, with the typography classes.
Variants, anatomy, accessibility, interaction and content rules

Variants

  • default — the steps sit on a sunken track; for side panels and narrow columns. The base class alone; no modifier class.
  • plain — no track; for steps on a page or inside a card.

Anatomy

Built from:

  • cmp-list-row, variant compact — each step: its number in ds-list-row__leading, its name in ds-list-row__text (with an optional ds-list-row__meta second line), and an optional status in ds-list-row__trailing. The current step carries aria-current="step" and gets the row's raised highlight.
  • cmp-status-pill, any tone — each step's state, shown with the with-status toggle.

Own parts:

  • Root: <nav class="ds-step-list" aria-label="Steps"> (or a <div> when the steps are not links); add ds-step-list--plain for the plain variant.
  • ds-step-list__steps: the <ol> of steps, one <li> per step.
  • ds-step-list__number: the step's position in a small circle; filled with ink on the current step.

Accessibility

  • Steps are an ordered list inside a nav named "Steps", so their count and order are announced.
  • The current step has aria-current="step"; its filled number, strong weight and raised highlight mark it without relying on colour.
  • Each step is one link (or plain text when steps cannot be opened); status pills are words, read after the step name.
  • The number is part of the link text, so "2 Add your team In review" reads in a sensible order.

Interaction

  • Rows answer hover and press with a colour change within the quick duration; nothing moves (int-01, int-03).
  • Moving to another step moves the current marker: the old number and the new one change fill over --ds-motion-quick, with the row's own highlight; focus stays on the link that was pressed (int-02).
  • Nothing moves or resizes; under the still preset and reduced motion the change is instant (int-04, int-06).

Content rules

  • Step names are short actions or outcomes in sentence case, two to four words: "Add your team".
  • Recovery steps say what went wrong ("Invite failed") and their second line says which step they recover from, by its number ("Recovery · from step 2"), so it stays short and never repeats a step name.
  • Use the product's status words consistently; one pill per step at most.

Do and don't

  • Do keep the steps in the flow's order and number them from 1.
  • Do mark exactly one current step when the list sits beside the step it describes.
  • Don't skip numbers for planned steps; a planned step is still a step.
  • Don't restyle the rows; use the compact variant of cmp-list-row as it is.
